query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
  AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged")
  AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated")
  AND ((attributes.condition != "Ready" AND attributes.status == "True") OR (attributes.condition == "Ready" AND attributes.status != "True"))
| STATS present = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition`)) BY attributes.condition, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
  AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged")
  AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated")
  AND ((attributes.condition != "Ready" AND attributes.status == "True") OR (attributes.condition == "Ready" AND attributes.status != "True"))
| STATS present = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/node/status_condition`)) BY attributes.condition, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Problem conditions over time (`node/status_condition`): a line at 1 while a pressure or node-problem-detector condition is True, or while `Ready` is not True. Informational conditions such as `KubeletConfigChanged` are left out, so an empty chart means no problems.
embeddableConfig.title: Node conditions over time

embeddableConfig.description: Conditions of this node whose latest status is a problem: `Ready` not True, or a pressure or node-problem-detector condition that is True. Since is when that status was first seen in the selected range. Informational conditions are left out.
esql_query:
FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_node"
| STATS since = MIN(@timestamp), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY attributes.condition, attributes.status
| STATS status = LAST(attributes.status, seen), since = LAST(since, seen) BY attributes.condition
| WHERE (attributes.condition != "Ready" AND status == "True" AND attributes.condition NOT IN ("KubeletConfigChanged", "SysctlChanged") AND NOT STARTS_WITH(attributes.condition, "Deprecated"))
   OR (attributes.condition == "Ready" AND status != "True")
| SORT since DESC
| LIMIT 100
